title: US Adult Tattoo Surveys Rose From 16% to 32%
hook: Surveyed US adults with tattoos doubled across the recorded years.
closing: The survey trend shows tattoos moving from subculture toward ordinary adult life.
question: How many tattoos do you have?

segments.say: The surveyed tattoo share reached 32 percent of US adults. That doubled the earliest value in the dataset.
Tattoo prevalence reached 37 percent among women. The pattern is now common, not confined to a narrow group.
More than one tattoo appeared among 22 percent of US adults. Repeat tattoos now outnumber single tattoos in the survey.
